Product Details: Powerful Cleaning, Convenient Design: This 1100-watt pressure washer (220-240 volts) delivers powerful cleaning performance. It features quick-connect wash and rinse nozzles, high-pressure foam application, and compact hose storage for easy use and organization. The pump features three cylinders made of durable plastic for reliable performance. High Pressure Washer with Double Filtration: Pressure washers use significantly less water than garden hoses, thanks to their 100-bar pressure, concentrated spray. The double filtration system further protects the tool from damage caused by unfiltered water, ensuring long-lasting performance. 360° Gun & Self-priming: Easily tackle any cleaning task with the Bosch 360° Gun. Its adjustable angle reaches even the toughest spots, while one-handed operation lets you maneuver and assist with ease. This self-priming pressure washer can draw water from an external source, offering greater flexibility. Nozzle with High Flow Rates: For deeper cleaning, especially on vehicles and bins, use the high-pressure detergent nozzle with its generous 450ml capacity. The range offers flow rates up to 270 l/h for quick and efficient work. Choose the right pressure level for each task—from light rinsing to tackling stubborn dirt—for optimal cleaning results. Safe Operation, Easy Setup: The BOSCH Easy Aquatak 100 is designed for water temperatures up to 40°C; using hotter water could cause damage. Push-fit connections make setup quick and convenient.
